## Setup

### Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(here)
```

### Import imputation df

```{r import-data}
df_impute <- readRDS(here("Imputed Data", "df_impute.rds"))
df_impute_y <- readRDS(here("Imputed Data", "df_impute_y.rds"))
```

### Initial checks

```{r initial-checks}
head(df_impute)
head(df_impute_y)
```

## 1. Data preparation

### 1.1 Variable types

```{r variable-types}
#-----------
# Main data
#-----------
# Convert PDS item 5 to factor
df_impute <- df_impute %>%
  mutate(pds_c_5 = factor(pds_c_5, levels = c(1, 4)))
table(df_impute$pds_c_5, useNA = "ifany")

# Ensure other PDS integer for PMM
pds_vars <- c("pds_c_1", "pds_c_2", "pds_c_3", "pds_c_4")
df_impute <- df_impute %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(pds_vars), ~ as.integer(.)))

#-------------------
# Young person data
#-------------------
# Convert PDS item 5 to factor
df_impute_y <- df_impute_y %>%
  mutate(pds_y_5 = factor(pds_y_5, levels = c(1, 4)))
table(df_impute_y$pds_y_5, useNA = "ifany")

# Convert other PDS to numeric for PMM
pds_vars_y <- c("pds_y_1", "pds_y_2", "pds_y_3", "pds_y_4")
df_impute_y <- df_impute_y %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(pds_vars_y), ~ as.integer(.)))
```

### 1.2 Imputation model variables

```{r vars-impute}
#-----------
# Main data
#-----------  
vars_impute <- unique(c(
  "sed_percentile",
  "pds_c_1","pds_c_2","pds_c_3","pds_c_4","pds_c_5",
  "age_cont",
  "adhd_status",
  "weight_c_1", 
  "height_c_1",
  grep("^ers_c", names(df_impute), value = TRUE),
  grep("^smfq_c", names(df_impute), value = TRUE),
  grep("^swan_c", names(df_impute), value = TRUE)
))

#-------------------
# Young person data
#-------------------
vars_impute_y <- c(
  "sed_percentile",
  "pds_y_1","pds_y_2","pds_y_3","pds_y_4","pds_y_5",
  "age_cont_y",
  "adhd_y",
  "weight_c_1", 
  "height_c_1",
  grep("^ers_y", names(df_impute_y), value = TRUE),
  grep("^smfq_y", names(df_impute_y), value = TRUE)
)
```

### 1.3 Define imputation methods

```{r imputation-methods}
#-----------------------
# Methods for main data
#-----------------------
methods <- setNames(rep("", length(vars_impute)), vars_impute)

# Continuous
continuous_vars <- c("sed_percentile", 
                     "pds_c_1",
                     "pds_c_2",
                     "pds_c_3",
                     "pds_c_4",
                     grep("^ers_c", names(df_impute), value = TRUE),
                     grep("^smfq_c", names(df_impute), value = TRUE),
                     grep("^swan_c", names(df_impute), value = TRUE))

methods[continuous_vars] <- "pmm"

# Menarche
methods["pds_c_5"] <- "logreg"

# Variables not imputed (but still predictors in model)
methods[c(
  "age_cont",
  "adhd_status",
  "weight_c_1", 
  "height_c_1"
)] <- ""

#-------------------------------
# Methods for young person data
#-------------------------------  
methods_y <- setNames(rep("", length(vars_impute_y)), vars_impute_y)

# Continuous
continuous_vars_y <- c("sed_percentile",
                       "pds_y_1",
                       "pds_y_2",
                       "pds_y_3",
                       "pds_y_4", 
                       "weight_c_1", 
                       "height_c_1")
methods_y[continuous_vars_y] <- "pmm"

# Menarche
methods_y["pds_y_5"] <- "logreg"

# ERS / SMFQ
methods_y[grep("^ers_y", names(methods_y))] <- "pmm"
methods_y[grep("^smfq_y", names(methods_y))] <- "pmm"

# Variables not imputed (but still predictors in model)
methods_y[c(
  "adhd_y",
  "age_cont_y"
)] <- ""
```

### 1.4 Define predictor matrix

```{r predictor-matrix}
#-------------------
# Main model matrix
#-------------------  
df_model <- df_impute[, vars_impute]
pred <- quickpred(df_model, mincor = 0.10, minpuc = 0.5)

# Check the matrix lines up with the imputation variables
stopifnot(identical(rownames(pred), vars_impute),
          identical(colnames(pred), vars_impute))

# Variables that are not imputed but should predict others
predict_only <- c(
  "age_cont",
  "adhd_status",
  "weight_c_1", 
  "height_c_1"
)

pred[, predict_only] <- 1

# Prevent self-prediction
diag(pred) <- 0

#---------------------------
# Young person model matrix
#---------------------------
df_model_y <- df_impute_y[, vars_impute_y]
pred_y <- quickpred(df_model_y, mincor = 0.10, minpuc = 0.5)

# Check the matrix lines up with the imputation variables
stopifnot(identical(rownames(pred_y), vars_impute_y),
          identical(colnames(pred_y), vars_impute_y))

# Variables that are not imputed but should predict others
predict_only_y <- c(
  "adhd_y",
  "age_cont_y"
)

pred_y[, predict_only_y] <- 1

# Prevent self-prediction
diag(pred_y) <- 0
```

## 2. Run mice

### 2.1 Main model

```{r c-run-mice}
# Run imputation
imp <- futuremice(
  data = df_model,              
  method = methods,             
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  m = 30,
  maxit = 20,
  parallelseed = 123
)

# Inspect results
completed_df <- complete(imp, 1)
head(completed_df)

# Save mids object
saveRDS(imp, here("Imputed Data", "imp.rds"))
```

### 2.2 Young person model

```{r y-run-mice}
# Run imputation
imp_y <- futuremice(
  data = df_model_y,              
  method = methods_y,             
  predictorMatrix = pred_y,
  m = 30,
  maxit = 20,
  parallelseed = 123
)

# Inspect results
completed_df_y <- complete(imp_y, 1)
head(completed_df_y)

# Save mids object
saveRDS(imp_y, here("Imputed Data", "imp_y.rds"))
```

## 3. Check imputations

### 3.1 Convergence and logged events

```{r check-imputation}
mice::convergence(imp)
mice::convergence(imp_y)

imp$loggedEvents
imp_y$loggedEvents
```

### 3.2 Trace plots for key continuous variables

```{r trace-plots}
#------------
# Main model
#------------
plot_vars <- c(
  "sed_percentile",
  "pds_c_1", "pds_c_2", "pds_c_3", "pds_c_4",
  paste0("ers_c_", 1:21),
  paste0("smfq_c_", 1:13),
  paste0("swan_c_", 1:18)
)

# Keep only variables that were actually imputed
imputed_vars <- names(imp$method[imp$method != ""])
plot_vars_imputed <- intersect(plot_vars, imputed_vars)

# Trace plots
plot(imp, plot_vars_imputed)

#--------------------
# Young person model
#--------------------
plot_vars_y <- c(
  "sed_percentile",
  "pds_y_1", "pds_y_2", "pds_y_3", "pds_y_4",
  "weight_c_1", "height_c_1",
  paste0("ers_y_", 1:21),
  paste0("smfq_y_", 1:13)
)

# Keep only variables that were actually imputed
imputed_vars_y <- names(imp_y$method[imp_y$method != ""])
plot_vars_imputed_y <- intersect(plot_vars_y, imputed_vars_y)

# Trace plots
plot(imp_y, plot_vars_imputed_y)
```

### 3.3 Stripplots

```{r stripplots}
#------------
# Main model
#------------
vars_to_plot <- intersect(plot_vars_imputed, names(imp$nmis[imp$nmis > 0]))

for (v in vars_to_plot) {
  message("Plotting: ", v)
  
  print(
    stripplot(
      imp,
      as.formula(paste(v, "~ .imp")),
      main = paste("Observed vs Imputed:", v),
      pch = 20,
      cex = 1.1
    )
  )
}


#--------------------
# Young person model
#--------------------
vars_to_plot_y <- intersect(plot_vars_imputed_y, names(imp_y$nmis[imp_y$nmis > 0]))

for (v in vars_to_plot_y) {
  message("Plotting: ", v)
  
  print(
    stripplot(
      imp_y,
      as.formula(paste(v, "~ .imp")),
      main = paste("Observed vs Imputed:", v),
      pch = 20,
      cex = 1.1
    )
  )
}
```

### 3.4 Means/ranges comparison between observed and imputed

```{r mean-ranges-comparison}
compare_mean_range <- function(imp_obj, var) {

  if (!var %in% names(imp_obj$data)) return(NULL)

  # observed data
  obs <- imp_obj$data[[var]]

  # completed stats across imputations
  comp_means <- numeric(imp_obj$m)
  comp_mins  <- numeric(imp_obj$m)
  comp_maxs  <- numeric(imp_obj$m)

  for (i in seq_len(imp_obj$m)) {
    x <- complete(imp_obj, i)[[var]]

    comp_means[i] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    comp_mins[i]  <- min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    comp_maxs[i]  <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # return tidy row
  tibble(
    variable       = var,
    obs_n          = sum(!is.na(obs)),
    obs_mean       = round(mean(obs, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    completed_mean = round(mean(comp_means), 2),
    obs_min        = round(min(obs, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    completed_min  = round(min(comp_mins), 2),
    obs_max        = round(max(obs, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    completed_max  = round(max(comp_maxs), 2)
  )
}

#------------
# Main model
#------------
results_table <- purrr::map_dfr(plot_vars_imputed, ~ compare_mean_range(imp, .x))
results_table

#--------------------
# Young person model
#--------------------
results_table_y <- purrr::map_dfr(plot_vars_imputed_y, ~ compare_mean_range(imp_y, .x))
results_table_y
```

### 3.5 Check missingness in imputed dfs

```{r imp-missingness-check}
remaining_missing <- function(imp_obj, label) {
  df1  <- complete(imp_obj, 1)
  vars <- names(imp_obj$imp)
  tibble(
    dataset   = label,
    variable  = vars,
    n_missing = unname(vapply(vars, function(v) sum(is.na(df1[[v]])), numeric(1)))
  )
}

missingness_summary <- bind_rows(
  remaining_missing(imp, "Main (caregiver) data"),
  remaining_missing(imp_y, "Young person data")
)

print(missingness_summary, n = Inf)
```

## 4. Merge with full dfs

```{r merge-full-dfs}
#------------
# Main data
#------------
df_full <- df_impute

# Create completed datasets with all original variables retained
completed_dfs <- lapply(1:imp$m, function(i) {
  
  # Extract one completed imputed dataset
  df_imputed <- complete(imp, i)
  
  # Start with full original dataset
  df_final <- df_full
  
  # Replace imputed variables with completed versions
  df_final[, vars_impute] <- df_imputed
  
  return(df_final)
})

# Example: first completed dataset
head(completed_dfs[[1]])
stopifnot(length(unique(completed_dfs[[1]]$LinkCode)) == nrow(df_impute))

#-------------------
# Young person data
#-------------------
df_full_y <- df_impute_y

# Create completed datasets with all original variables retained
completed_dfs_y <- lapply(1:imp_y$m, function(i) {
  
  # Extract one completed imputed dataset
  df_imputed_y <- complete(imp_y, i)
  
  # Start with full original dataset
  df_final_y <- df_full_y
  
  # Replace imputed variables with completed versions
  df_final_y[, vars_impute_y] <- df_imputed_y
  
  return(df_final_y)
})

# Example: first completed dataset
head(completed_dfs_y[[1]])
stopifnot(length(unique(completed_dfs_y[[1]]$LinkCode)) == nrow(df_impute_y))
```

## 5. Save lists of completed dfs

```{r save-completed-dfs}
saveRDS(completed_dfs, here("Imputed Data", "completed_dfs.rds"))
saveRDS(completed_dfs_y, here("Imputed Data", "completed_dfs_y.rds"))
```
